title: Routh reduction by stages for free proper actions on hyperregular G-invariant G-hyperregular systems with an equivariant normal-subgroup connection, connected restricted isotropy and compatible regular momenta
author: Bavo Langerock; Tom Mestdag; Joris Vankerschaver
difficulty_reason: Hamiltonian reduction by stages does not itself supply a magnetic Lagrangian or the residual velocity regularity needed for a second Routh reduction. The authors construct the descended magnetic potential, prove its isotropy-orbit invariance using connectedness, identify the residual momentum map and invert its velocity restriction. Their tangent/cotangent shift and energy identities then produce the exact correspondence of the two reduced Euler-Lagrange dynamics.
